intro: In the Undercity's Apothecarium, Andron Gant handles occasional commissions and relic recoveries for local scholars. He is a reclusive Forsaken, often drunk, and rarely leaves the city.

p: Andron Gant spends his time in the Apothecarium, among its noxious fumes, and rarely ventures beyond the Undercity's stone walls. He seems little more than a drunken scholar. For local mages, he sometimes hires couriers to seek obscure relics on distant shores, including the Tablet of Markri.
